# Equations nested deep

Each of these is short to write and was slow to lay out: an accent, a pair
of delimiters or a fraction measured what it holds and then laid it out,
which doubled the work at every level. The first one, 124 letters, stopped
the window. Now each opens at once.

Thirty accents in a row, inline: $\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar\bar x$, and the text goes on after it.

| Nested | Equation |
|:-------|:---------|
| 25 pairs of delimiters | $\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(\left(x\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)$ |
| powers, 20 deep | $x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x^{x}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}$ |

- Delimiters with a bar in the middle, 12 deep:

$$
\left( a_{0} \middle| \left( a_{1} \middle| \left( a_{2} \middle| \left( a_{3} \middle| \left( a_{4} \middle| \left( a_{5} \middle| \left( a_{6} \middle| \left( a_{7} \middle| \left( a_{8} \middle| \left( a_{9} \middle| \left( a_{10} \middle| \left( a_{11} \middle| x\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)\right)
$$

- A continued fraction of 16 levels, and 20 roots:

$$
\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+\frac{1}{1+x}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}
$$

$$
\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+\sqrt{1+x}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}}
$$
